items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to switch customer sessions, hijack accounts, and access private data. Exploitation attempts were observed shortly after public disclosure.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability Leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Security Feature Bypass in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability Leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. Adobe recommends users update their installations to the newest version.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce via REST API
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images, bypassing validation. Mass attacks exploiting this vulnerability have been observed.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability Leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
